title: Key Role of the Lewis Base Position in Asymmetric Bifunctional Catalysis: Design and Evaluation of a New Ligand for Chiral Polymetallic Catalysts

synthesis.procedure: To a solution of ligand 7 (89.0 mg, 0.20 mmol) in THF (3.0 mL) was added Gd(OiPr)3 (0.2 M in THF, 500 μL, 0.10 mmol) at room temperature. The mixture was stirred at 54 °C for 1 h, and the solvent was evaporated at 0 °C. The residue was dried under reduced pressure (<5 mmHg) for 2 h, then propionitrile (350 μL) was added. After 1 day, colorless prisms appeared. The solvent was removed, and the crystals were washed twice with propionitrile and dried under vacuum to afford the 3:4+2OH crystal (68 mg, 77% yield). The crystal contains six propionitrile molecules and a tetrahedral-bipyramidal Gd3 core with two hydroxyl groups at the apical Gd sites. The absolute configuration of ligand 7 was assigned from the Flack parameter (−0.006(4)).
synthesis.temperature: room temperature addition; 54 °C stirring; evaporation at 0 °C
synthesis.time: 1 h at 54 °C, then 2 h drying, then 1 day crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution synthesis followed by crystallization from propionitrile
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent evaporated at 0 °C; residue dried at <5 mmHg for 2 h; propionitrile (350 μL) added; colorless prisms after 1 day, washed twice with propionitrile, and dried under vacuum.
